tasks.title: Memoise wapor_plan_time_slices() and wapor_temporal_codes()
tasks.notes: Distinct from 7.3 (which covers .load_metadata_catalog()). wapor_plan_time_slices() and wapor_temporal_codes() are both pure/deterministic given identical args but are not memoise::memoise()-wrapped, unlike the 3 structurally identical examples already in the package (wapor_generate_urls in api_client.R:367, wapor_variable_metadata in metadata.R:466, .load_metadata_catalog_cached in wapor_metadata_cache.R:192). Benchmarked 2026-09-17: not a CPU bottleneck by itself (~0.1-0.2s even for a 9-year daily-only D plan, 324 rows via `Rscript.exe` R-4.4.1 local run) but repeated identical calls -- e.g. wapor_run_monitoring() looping variables for the same season window, or repeated re-runs of seasonal AETI/ETc extraction scripts during iteration on the citrus (177 farms, Mar-Feb) and Savola (75 fields, 4 seasons) projects -- redo the same greedy interval decomposition every time. Fix: rename current body to wapor_plan_time_slices_internal()/wapor_temporal_codes_internal(), wrap with memoise::memoise() following the existing api_client.R pattern exactly, keep the exported name and signature unchanged. memoise is already an Imports dependency, no new packages needed. Add a cache-hit regression test (call twice with identical args, assert identical() result) and confirm the full test-plan_wapor_time_slices.R suite (20 tests) still passes. User asked to log this for later review/implementation in a future session, not implemented yet.

Reproduced with Int16 scale-0.1 COGs on terra 1.7.65 and 1.9.50: 2.5 instead of 25 mm/dekad, 0.25 instead of 2.5 mm/day. Fixed by clearing the file scale on open and applying it once after the crop; catalogue scale no longer applied.

issues.title: wapor_write_cog() truncated floats to INT4U when the top rows were integers
issues.summary: Probe read only the first rows of layer 1; a zero band gave INT4U and truncated fractions (mean 2.45 -> 1.96). Now checks all values up to 5e6, else a regular sample over all layers.

issues.title: Tiled engine read source layers with template row/col indices (silent all-NA output)
issues.summary: Tiles were cut from sources by template row/col indices; any source on another grid gave all-NA tiles. Tiling moved into the shared kernel reading by extent plus halo. Verified: offset read 4041/4042/4043; live L1 tiled equals memory (max diff 0).

issues.title: Monitoring stores whole rasters as DuckDB blobs
issues.summary: Every query deserialises whole rasters before cropping to the farm. Not fixed (user decision Q9: storage-format change, needs migration).

issues.title: Remote seasonal analysis could not match WaPOR dekad file names
issues.summary: YYYY-MM-D1/D2/D3 labels were not parsed, so data_source='api' failed for every request in 1.0.0 (verified live). Fixed; live smoke test passes.

issues.title: GDAL curl capability probe always reported missing
issues.summary: Probe searched a non-existent 'longname' column for 'vsicurl'; false warning on load and forced full downloads under the download fallback. Now detects GDAL's HTTP driver.

issues.title: Remote COG streaming retries stopped before pixel I/O
issues.where: R/utils.R, R/seasonal_download.R, R/wapor_map.R, R/wapor_ts.R, R/analysis_tiled.R, R/wapor_cog.R
issues.summary: Existing retry, completeness, and datatype safeguards are retained. Live timing showed the remote open is not the bottleneck; Codex added granular map and Shiny progress for the formerly silent crop-and-write phase. Parse, Shiny construction, 138 focused assertions, and a 12-layer live output run passed.

issues.title: Dashboard crashes on every board_claim.ps1 update (UTF-8 BOM)
issues.summary: app.py's load_board() decoded agents-board.json as plain utf-8. board_claim.ps1 (PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding utf8) always writes a UTF-8 BOM, which json.loads rejects outright -- meaning the dashboard had been broken since the first board_claim.ps1 call ever made against the file, surfaced only now because coord-board-v1's original smoke test ran before any board_claim.ps1 write existed. Fixed by decoding with utf-8-sig (tolerates BOM or no BOM). Verified by relaunching and confirming HTTP 200 with no traceback, plus a direct check that task data renders correctly.

issues.title: Duplicate %||% with conflicting semantics; triplicated level->URL mapping
issues.summary: Two %||% definitions with different semantics (load-order dependent, no Collate: field); level->base-URL mapping hardcoded independently 3x. Fixed with one canonical length-aware %||% in utils.R and one .wapor_level_workspace_url() helper. Full suite 0 fail / 1019 passed.

issues.title: L3 seasonal planning trusts a static, region-blind availability list
issues.summary: Resolved with cache-backed temporal discovery and region/period URL checks; planner regression and full test suites pass.

issues.title: Seasonal download pipeline could silently serve wrong or incomplete data
issues.summary: Weak checksum cache key, no retry on vsicurl open, no reconciliation on partial failure. Fixed with SHA-256 keys, retry-with-backoff, missing_periods tracking.
